changes.comment: Move the built-in Feishu channel implementation into the publishable @excitedjs/feishu-channel package and depend on it by default (issue #209 slice 5). Core resolves `builtin:feishu` through the Channel provider loader/catalog and passes the provider-validated config plus neutral host state/cache roots into `ChannelProvider.createSession`; there is no core-owned Feishu adapter path. The Feishu package owns the live session, target resolution, MCP descriptor, `reply` / `react` / `list_chat_bots` tool handlers, inbound normalization, access/trust behavior, and platform I/O. Routing, binding state, authorization, Team lifecycle, and the generic `channel.invoke_tool` conduit stay core-owned. No operator action required on upgrade.
